newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising on institutional support.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising on institutional support.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to move upwards slightly amid institutional support and buying by small investors, brokers said.
"The market will move forward slowly but steadily. The market sentiment is positive. We welcome its steady growth," said broker M.A. Hossain.
Brokers said cement, food and pharmaceutical shares with sound financial base might be attractive to the investors. Institutional support to the market is also expected, they said.
The DSE all-share price index gained 9.36 points or 0.13 percent at 1,215.51 on turnover of 76.2 million taka on Tuesday.
